text.en: HuggingChat is row 49 of the BenchCouncil AI100 (2022-2023) annual table in the LLM area.
text.zh: HuggingChat 是 BenchCouncil AI100（2022-2023）年度表第 49 行，所属领域为“大语言模型”。

text.en: The annual table leaves the publication field blank for HuggingChat.
